job_types.report_collect: implemented, subject to collection pipeline limitations
job_types.custom: implemented for an exact module-and-function whitelist
job_types.memory_review: implemented as a read-only explicit task scan and local report

fallback: Without APScheduler the service reports degraded mode and refuses schedule creation rather than persisting false-active jobs
recovery: Malformed jobs.json is moved to a timestamped .corrupt file; active jobs that cannot be restored are persisted with error status instead of remaining false-active
